source.dataset: Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), national CSV files (accident.csv)

limits: Fatal crashes only: a crash on a public road in which someone died within 30 days. Injury-only and property-damage crashes are not in FARS.
The city is the place FARS coded the crash to; a crash just outside the city limit counts for the county, so the county figure is given beside it.
Counts, not rates: no population or traffic denominator is applied.

new-york-ny.county: the five boroughs (New York, Kings, Queens, Bronx and Richmond counties)

new-york-city-ny.county: the five boroughs (New York, Kings, Queens, Bronx and Richmond counties)
